page.overview:
Who is Cell 17?

Cell 17 retains Cell's face, but now dons a short orange scarf reminiscent of Android 17. He also has much clothing taken from Super 17, including his armbands and lower half.

According to his profile, he is the ultimate man-made warrior due to being the ultimate machine mutant and ultimate android combined.

Due to possessing both components of the ultimate Machine Mutant and Android, Cell 17 is truly one of the most powerful warriors. Dragon Ball Fusions lists Cell 17 as an S-rank fighter, listing him as around the same level of strength as Super Saiyan 4 Goku or Super Saiyan 4 Vegeta, though extremely powerful G-rank warriors such as Vegito Blue and Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta outclass him by a wide margin.
